title: Parametric bushing
prompt:
All dimensions are millimetres. Build exactly what is described — no fillets, chamfers, draft or extra features unless the description asks for them. Leave the finished part in the document; do not export anything.

A bushing driven by document variables, so that changing a variable
changes the part:
- create a variable `bore` = 12 and a variable `wall` = 6;
- build a bushing 30 long with its axis on Z, from Z=0 to Z=30, centred on the
  Z axis, whose bore diameter is driven by `bore` and whose outside diameter is
  driven by the expression `bore + 2 * wall`;
- then change `bore` to 20 and leave the model regenerated at that value.
The finished part must be a 20 bore, 32 outside diameter, 30 long bushing that
would follow another change to `bore`.

checks.why: the OD followed bore + 2*wall after the edit
the bore regenerated to the new value
the outside is round and followed the expression

doc_checks.name: bore
doc_checks.why: the variable exists and holds the edited value
geometry is DRIVEN by the variable, not retyped
